The application requests location only a: The application requests location only after you select Use my location. Your browser or operating system decides how to estimate it and may use GPS, nearby Wi-Fi networks, mobile network signals, an IP-address estimate or other device and platform signals. Those location services are controlled by the browser, operating system and device provider, not by this application, and may have their own privacy practices.
